originalThought: QUELLE (Long 1862): 4.7 'Take away thy opinion...'; 8.47 '...not this thing... but thy own judgement...'; 12.17 'if it is not true, do not say it'. Separate the fact from the judgment about it.
softwareInterpretation: INTERPRETATION (two roles): (a) meta — separate observation from evaluation and make uncertainty explicit, which grounds separating severity from confidence; (b) for code — declaration should match behavior; contradictions between claimed architecture/signature and actual behavior are findings.
preconditions: There is a declared contract (layer rule, visibility, type) to compare against actual facts.
limits: Not every architecture is declared; without explicit rules no violation can be detected. The meta role is a product property, not automatic code detection. Avoid double-counting cases the type system already covers.
counterexamples: A deliberately documented, justified exception to a layer rule.
A case already covered by the type checker (no separate stoa finding).
